entries.content: there! That's an interesting symbol you've got there. Let's see if I can dig up some info for ya. It looks kinda like a yin-yang symbol, but with more curves and points. The yin-yang represents the duality of life - the interconnectedness of seemingly opposing forces (like dark and light, female and male). This symbol seems to have similar themes, but with its own twist. I couldn't find any definitive sources for this specific symbol, but I did notice that it shows up in some ancient art and even modern tattoos, often associated with balance, harmony, and the interconnectedness of all things. If you happen to know more about where this symbol originated, that would definitely help pin down its meaning! Anyway, if you've got other curiosities or symbols that catch your eye, feel free to share them! I love a good mystery. 🕵️‍♂️
